title: Skip the Great Wall Crowds? Xi'an Has the Wall You Can Ride Around | China Travel Expert
description:
Everyone books the Great Wall. Almost no one plans for this one — and it might be the better half-day. Xi'an's Ming-dynasty city wall is the most complete ancient city wall left in China: a full rectangle about 13.7 km around, roughly 12 m tall, built in the 1370s on Tang-era foundations.

The best part is you don't just look at it — you get up on top and ride it. Rent a bike at the gate and you can loop the entire circuit in about 90 minutes, with the whole old city on one side and the moat on the other. Do it near sunset and the watchtowers light up one by one.

So here's the debate: Great Wall day trip from the far side of the country, or a sunset lap on a wall you can actually circle in an afternoon?

★ Expert Tip: bikes are rented by time at the South Gate (Yongningmen) — start there and ride counter-clockwise so the low sun is behind you for photos.

西安明城墙：全长约13.7公里，高约12米，1370年代始建，是中国现存最完整的古城墙——可以租自行车在城墙上骑行一圈，约90分钟。
